items.question: At which international conference was the UAE's National Net Zero by 2050 target unveiled, as supported by the UAE Government's Net Zero 2050 Charter?
items.gold: It was unveiled at the 27th Conference of the Parties (COP27).
items.fact: Net Zero 2050 target unveiled at COP27 conference

items.question: How many emirates' governments affirmed their commitment to the National Net Zero by 2050 through the UAE Government's Net Zero 2050 Charter?
items.gold: The governments of the seven emirates signed the charter.
items.fact: Seven emirates' governments signed the Net Zero 2050 Charter
